    Create & edit images with Notion AI

    In this help doc

    Learn how to turn ideas into diagrams, flowcharts, and visual notes, then tweak them with AI.

    Jump to FAQs

    Create and edit images with Notion Agent to make diagrams, flowcharts, and visual notes, then refine them with follow-up instructions. Workspace owners and admins control whether image generation is switched on for their workspace.

    • Image generation is available on Business and Enterprise plans.

    • If you manage your billing in-product:

      • Business and Enterprise plans include a usage allowance for certain Notion AI features.

      • Learn more about managing usage allowance for Notion AI →

    • If you work with an account team:

      • Image generation has the following limits per user: 10 image generations or edits per 24 hours. 30 image generations or edits per 30 days.

      • These limits reset on a rolling basis.

    • Custom Agents can’t generate images.

    Where you can create or edit images

    • Generate a new image in an image block.

    • Edit an existing image with AI.

    • Chat with Notion Agent to make or edit images (the chat uses key info from the page you’re viewing).

    Create an image in an image block

    1. Type /image on a page and press Enter.

    2. In the image block, choose the Notion AI option.

    3. Tell Notion Agent what you want to create. You can also pick a style to guide the result.

    4. Generate the image, then refine the prompt until it looks right.

    Note: On mobile, you can generate images only through Notion Agent chat (not in image blocks, or for cover images).

    Edit an existing image with AI

    1. Hover over an image in Notion.

    2. Select the edit with AI option.

    3. Describe the change you want (for example, "change the background to a snowy afternoon," "make this look like a diagram," or "make this look more professional").

    4. Refine with extra instructions until you're happy with the result.

    Make or edit images in Notion Agent chat

    You can ask Notion Agent in chat to make or edit an image. This works well when you want the image to reflect content on your page.

    Try prompts like:

    • "Create a flowchart for the process described on this page."

    • "Make a quick infographic summarizing the key points from this doc."

    • "Turn this into a simple slide layout."

    • "Turn this screenshot into a polished diagram."

    FAQs

    Why don't I see the option to create an image?

    Image generation is only available on Business and Enterprise plans. If you don't see it yet, the feature might still be rolling out to your workspace. Check that your admin has enabled image generation in workspace settings.

    HIPAA-enabled workspaces can't use image generation.

    Why am I getting an error?

    You may have hit your rolling, six-hour or monthly usage allowance for Notion AI. Learn more about what to do when certain Notion AI features are temporarily unavailable after reaching your usage allowance →
